rubric.description: (a) Uses a loop that continues while digits remain
(a) Accumulates the sum correctly and returns it (returns 0 for input 0)
(b) Returns false when `n <= 0` (and does not divide by zero)
(b) Tests divisibility with `%` and returns the correct boolean
(a) Computes hours using integer division by 3600
(a) Computes minutes using the remainder after hours, divided by 60
(a) Adds a leading zero for minutes and seconds that are less than 10
(a) Builds and returns the string in the form h:mm:ss
(b) Uses integer division and multiplication by `unit` to produce a multiple of `unit`
(b) Adds half of `unit` before dividing so that values are rounded to the nearest multiple, with exact ties going up
